tender.title: Dental Implants, Digital Services & Associated Products
tender.description: NHS Greater Glasgow & Clyde (NHS GGC) require suitably qualified, experienced and licensed contractors to undertake the provision of Dental Implants, Digital Services and Associated Products, in order to procure a high quality solution across the Board. The tender opportunity consists of six primary lots. Suppliers successfully appointed to one or more of Lots 1 to 6 shall automatically qualify for participation within Lot 7 (Innovation). No separate appointment process is required for Lot 7.

criteria.description:
All bidders must complete the Single Procurement Document (SPD) via the Public Contracts Scotland - Tender (PCS-T) portal. Bidders must read the SPD in conjunction with all of the sections set out. Failure to provide information will exclude bidders from participation in the tender stage.
With reference to SPD Question 4A.2a, bidders must confirm that they hold the particular authorisation or memberships:
Bidders must hold, or be capable of demonstrating compliance through an equivalent certification or standard UKAS or Equivalent ISO Certification such as ISO 9001:2015 or ISO 13485:2016 certification accredited by UKAS or an internationally recognized body; which must cover all relevant activities (e.g. manufacturing, distribution)
AND
Cyber Essentials Plus certification or completion of an Information Security Third Party Questionnaire if handling patient data or supplying software.

With reference to SPD question 4B.6, NHS Greater Glasgow and Clyde reserves the right to undertake proportionate financial due diligence during the procurement process and throughout the term of any resulting Framework.
criteria.minimum:
With reference to SPD question 4B.5.1b, EO's must hold and evidence Employer’s (Compulsory) Liability Insurance = GBP 5m. If EO's do not currently have this level of insurance, they must agree to put it in place prior to contract commencement. This is a pass/fail question. In failing, EO's will be excluded from participation in the tender stage.
With reference to SPD question 4B.5.2, EO's must hold and evidence Public Liability Insurance = GBP 5m; and Professional Indemnity Insurance = GBP 2m. If EO's do not currently have this level of insurance, they must agree to put it in place prior to contract commencement. This is a pass/fail question. In failing, EO's will be excluded from participation in the tender stage.

criteria.description:
With reference to SPD question 4C1.2 bidders are required to provide examples that demonstrate they have the relevant experience to deliver the services. Examples must be from within the last three (3) years. Bidders must provide details of three (3) instances of the organisation’s experience in delivering services similar to those described. If applicable, the Board would prefer these similar services to be related to a contract undertaken by the consortium or the leading company and their sub-contractor(s). Use the template uploaded with this Contract Notice only to respond. If you do not provide three (3) examples of experience or references, this will be a non-compliant request to participate and your tender will be excluded from the tender stage.
With reference to SPD question 4C.3, bidders are required to demonstrate that they have (or have access to) the appropriate technical facilities, study and research facilities and quality measures to deliver the types of requirements detailed.
With reference to SPD question 4C.9, bidders will be required to demonstrate that they have (or have access to) the relevant tools, equipment, digital systems, software platforms and technical infrastructure necessary.to deliver the types of requirements detailed in the Specification.
criteria.minimum:
With reference to SPD question 4D.1 Tenderers must evidence or commit to obtain ISO9001 or other documented quality management system endorsed by the organisation’s Chief Executive or equivalent.
With reference to SPD question 4D.1 EO’s must hold and evidence or commit to obtain, within 6 months of the contract start date, a whistleblowing policy consistent with the National Whistleblowing Standards that can be found at the following link:
https://inwo.spso.org.uk/national-whistleblowing-%20standards
With reference to SPD question 4D.2 EO’s must evidence or commit to obtain ISO14001 or other documented quality management system endorsed by the organisation’s Chief Executive or equivalent.
